questions.q: What does the northfield-raw-crawler actually do to the CSV files in northfield-raw-zone?
options: It scans them and registers table schemas/partitions in the Glue Data Catalog, without moving or copying the underlying data
It copies every file into a new S3 bucket in a cleaned format
It deletes the raw files once cataloged
It loads the data directly into Redshift
questions.explain: A Glue crawler catalogs data in place — it registers schema and partition metadata, it never moves or transforms the source files.

questions.q: What two tables does northfield-raw-crawler create in northfield_catalog?
options: northfield_orders_raw and northfield_inventory_raw
fact_orders and dim_product
northfield_orders_curated and northfield_inventory_curated
orders_2026_09_19 and inventory_2026_09_19
questions.explain: One table per raw prefix: northfield_orders_raw from orders/, and northfield_inventory_raw from inventory/.

questions.q: Why is northfield-raw-crawler configured to run on demand rather than on its own cron schedule?
options: Step Functions already knows when the night's upload finished (via the _SUCCESS marker) and triggers the crawler at the right time
Glue crawlers cannot be scheduled at all
On-demand crawlers are cheaper regardless of orchestration
AWS requires all crawlers in a Data Catalog to run on demand
questions.explain: A crawler on its own schedule risks running before or redundant with the actual upload; Step Functions is the single place that decides when the chain runs.

questions.q: Does the Glue crawler clean or correct data types and values (e.g. fixing order_date or inconsistent region values)?
options: No — it only infers types from the CSV headers; cleaning and correction happen in the Glue ETL job
Yes, the crawler fully cleans and validates every column
Yes, but only for numeric columns
The crawler deletes any row with inconsistent data
questions.explain: The crawler's job is to make raw data visible via inferred schema, not to correct it — that's explicitly the ETL job's responsibility in Lesson 5.

questions.q: What keeps repeated crawls fast as northfield-raw-zone accumulates many daily dt= partitions over time?
options: Partition indexing
Deleting old partitions automatically
Switching the crawler to run continuously
Reducing the number of raw files per day
questions.explain: Glue's partition indexing keeps re-crawls efficient even as a table accumulates a year or more of daily dt= partitions.
